management.src: If the short leg's delta exceeds 0.80, the spread is near max profit — close it rather than waiting for the last 10%, because the short leg's assignment risk rises faster than the remaining profit.

exits.src: MANDATORY ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close the short call no later than 15:40 ET on expiration day, unconditionally, even though it is covered by the long call.

unexpressed.text: LEVEL 3 LEGAL: the short call is covered by the lower-strike long call in the same expiry within the same multi-leg order. Alpaca accepts it.
unexpressed.reason: structural: the template enforces this shape, so there is nothing for a predicate to check

unexpressed.text: Submit as a single 2-leg order. Never leg it.
unexpressed.reason: order mechanics: owned by optexec, not by the IR

unexpressed.text: Long leg by delta: nearest listed strike with delta in [0.75, 0.85]. Short leg by delta: nearest listed strike with delta in [0.15, 0.25].
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: Width test: (short_strike - long_strike) >= 1.5 x (spot x IV x sqrt(DTE/365)), so the cap sits beyond the expected move.
Cost test: net_debit <= 0.65 x (short_strike - long_strike) x 100, giving at least a 1:0.54 risk/reward.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: Size: net debit per unit <= 2% of equity ($1,000), so a full loss costs 2% of the account.
unexpressed.reason: unclassified: no matcher recognised this phrasing

unexpressed.text: Close at 50% of the maximum profit ((width x 100) - debit), or at 21 DTE, whichever comes first.
unexpressed.reason: an exit or stop this compiler could not express

unexpressed.text: Hard stop: close at a 50% loss of the net debit.
unexpressed.reason: an exit or stop this compiler could not express

unexpressed.text: Do not roll a losing debit spread; close it and re-evaluate the thesis.
unexpressed.reason: rolling is not implemented in v1 (design 5.4)

unexpressed.text: If both legs finish ITM, close the spread rather than allowing exercise and assignment to offset — the offset is exact in payoff but involves two 100-share movements and settlement timing between them.
unexpressed.reason: assignment prose: the machine-readable part is the guard, which is compiled separately where the sentence gives a time or a threshold
